description: The sync history for ONE source, newest first — status, when it ran, how many records it fetched/created/updated, and the error message when it failed. This is the answer to "the data looks stale" and "did my sync actually do anything": a source can sit at status active and be failing every cycle. Covers scheduled runs and sync_source runs alike.
